title: M1 milestone: Library spine + KnowledgeObject + vault-as-projection
description:
Discharges DESIGN.md §6 test #5: the Obsidian vault can be deleted and fully regenerated from the Library as a projection.

Scope (from ROADMAP.md):
- SqliteLibrary: implement the Library trait in SQLite (object store, identity/dedup, query, citation-edges table).
- VaultProjection: render Library state to Markdown + YAML + wikilinks; regeneration command.
- Annotation model: human-authored notes as Library objects; near-term structured intake.
- Seed hand-authored KnowledgeObjects so the projection loop can be exercised without real ingestion.

Done-conditions (self-checkable):
1. A command regenerates the entire vault from the Library.
2. Deleting the vault directory and re-running reproduces it (diff empty modulo intended nondeterminism).
3. A human annotation added via the intake channel survives delete-and-regenerate (proves §9.4).
4. Regenerating the vault makes zero LLM calls.
5. The Library is the only component holding durable state; the projection holds none.
